propositions: Empty file_impact is overloaded, conflating undeclared edits with genuinely no file edits, causing conservative whole-HEAD invalidation even when no files are touched
A single non-closed child with empty file_impact poisons the entire container's inherited drift scope, collapsing siblings' careful declarations to whole-HEAD invalidation
Explicit tri-state (undeclared, paths, none) with required no_file_impact_reason for none-state allows precise attestation validity scoping and eliminates false positives
A ticket explicitly declaring no file impact must preserve plan-review attestation validity across unrelated commits, while undeclared tickets must remain invalidated by any commit
Container roll-up must treat explicitly declared no-file-impact children as neutral (non-poisoning) and exclude them from inherited drift scope calculation
